summary: Iter 414 — Full parity pass on web + mobile for the agentic visual-editor batch. All 8 verification items PASS. WEB (1920x1080, samburke@test.com): dashboard-at-a-glance hero bg is white (rgb(251,252,254), NOT dark teal); the three uniform metric tiles have solid coloured backgrounds — Available tile rgb(14,77,82) teal, glance-spent rgb(158,47,35) red, glance-spare rgb(165,81,43) clay — each with white text + mini white bar. glance-care-management = solid teal tint rgb(201,224,225) with teal left border; glance-forfeit = solid clay tint rgb(244,214,197) with clay left border; glance-shortfall conditional (demo account is underspend_risk so forfeit renders but shortfall is correctly hidden). Gauge row shows '% spent' and does NOT show any 'time gone' / '% of time gone' text. FundtrackAlerts renders on dashboard (1 card) with ZERO ft-alert-action-* buttons. WeeklyBudget /app/weekly-budget: weekly-used heading is Title Case 'What You Have Recorded This Quarter'; weekly-used-table renders with Service/Date/Source/Amount/Actions; sort/search/filter controls (weekly-used-sort-service/date/amount, weekly-used-search, weekly-used-filter-source) all present; search 'Per' filters rows correctly; Edit flow opens edit-entry-dialog, PATCH /api/fundtrack/charges/<id> succeeds (row amount updates to 77.77, restored to 76.5 after). WhatIfCareDialog: whatif-saved exposes 17 options (1 placeholder + 16 saved services — cap of 12 removed); whatif-price has visible '$' prefix in its wrapper. MOBILE (390x844, Expo preview): dashboard glance row shows '% used' and NO 'quarter elapsed' / '% of quarter' text. FundtrackAlerts has 0 ft-alert-action-* buttons. Ask Wayly screen: header-back-button present, ask-input present, bottom tab bar hidden on /ask (tab-dashboard not visible), aw2-empty visible before typing and disappears when text is entered (suggestions count 0 after typing), ask-send-button renders at bottom (arrow-up) with composer hugging the keyboard area. WhatIfCareSheet (source-verified at /app/mobile/src/components/fundtrack/WhatIfCareSheet.tsx:105): savedServices mapped verbatim without slice cap; Field label is literally 'Price per visit ($)'. No parity divergence between web and mobile. No critical or minor bugs found.

WhatIfCareDialog.jsx:91 — '$' prefix uses absolute-positioned span inside relative wrapper with pl-7 on the Input; keyboard focus still targets the number input cleanly.

WeeklyBudget.jsx — table markup uses weekly-used-table + per-row data-testid weekly-used-<id>; edit/delete reuse existing PATCH/DELETE endpoints. End-to-end update round-trip (77.77) confirmed reflected in UI immediately after save.
